mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, customer_id, old_owner_id, new_owner_id, changed_by, effective_at, reason, approval_ref, created_at FROM crm_customer_owner_history WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT h.id, h.customer_id, h.old_owner_id, ou.display_name AS old_owner_name, h.new_owner_id, nu.display_name AS new_owner_name, h.changed_by, cu.display_name AS changed_by_name, h.reason, h.approval_ref, h.effective_at, h.created_at FROM crm_customer_owner_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON ou.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ou.id = h.old_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user nu ON nu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND nu.id = h.new_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND cu.id = h.changed_by WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.id = #{id}

SELECT h.id, h.customer_id, h.old_owner_id, ou.display_name AS old_owner_name, h.new_owner_id, nu.display_name AS new_owner_name, h.changed_by, cu.display_name AS changed_by_name, h.reason, h.approval_ref, h.effective_at, h.created_at FROM crm_customer_owner_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON ou.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ou.id = h.old_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user nu ON nu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND nu.id = h.new_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND cu.id = h.changed_by WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.approval_ref = #{approvalRef} ORDER BY h.id ASC

SELECT h.id, h.customer_id, h.old_owner_id, ou.display_name AS old_owner_name, h.new_owner_id, nu.display_name AS new_owner_name, h.changed_by, cu.display_name AS changed_by_name, h.reason, h.approval_ref, h.effective_at, h.created_at FROM crm_customer_owner_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON ou.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ou.id = h.old_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user nu ON nu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND nu.id = h.new_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND cu.id = h.changed_by WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND h.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY h.id DESC

SELECT h.id, h.customer_id, c.customer_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.display_name, ''), NULLIF(c.nickname, ''), c.customer_no) AS customer_name, h.old_owner_id, ou.display_name AS old_owner_name, h.new_owner_id, nu.display_name AS new_owner_name, h.changed_by, cu.display_name AS changed_by_name, h.reason, h.approval_ref, h.effective_at, h.created_at FROM crm_customer_owner_history h INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND c.id = h.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ou ON ou.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND ou.id = h.old_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user nu ON nu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND nu.id = h.new_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND cu.id = h.changed_by
ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer_owner_history h INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND c.id = h.customer_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_owner_history (tenant_id, customer_id, old_owner_id, new_owner_id, changed_by, effective_at, reason, approval_ref) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{customerId}, #{oldOwnerId}, #{newOwnerId}, #{changedBy}, #{effectiveAt}, #{reason}, #{approvalRef})
